label: Time-symmetry and momentary-PSR controls: eternal and begun inertia, nonvacuity
paraphrase: Closed controls on interpretations with one world, integer times and two individuals, false alone with received esse; statements about these interpretations only. (1) Eternal inertia (both individuals present at every moment, no giving, no cause of being): Schmid's origin-or-inertia explanation satisfies the momentary PSR and the cessation law; the productive bridge and 40a97664 fail; false is homogeneous; coverage fails while exercise and time symmetry hold; concurrent actualization for homogeneous things fails. (2) Eternal, true causes false's being and gives at moment 0 only: coverage and exercise hold; time symmetry and the homogeneous conclusion fail. (3) Eternal, true causes false's being and never gives: coverage and time symmetry hold; exercise and the homogeneous conclusion fail. (4) Begun inertia (false present from moment 0 on, given being at moment 0 only): coverage, exercise, time symmetry, the momentary PSR on Schmid's explanation, the cessation law and received onset is given (fa3e228b) hold; 40a97664 fails while concurrent actualization for homogeneous things holds, since false is not homogeneous. (5) Eternal sustaining (true gives false being at every moment): every premise of both derivations, 40a97664 and the homogeneous conclusion hold. (6) No explanations: the productive bridge holds vacuously; the momentary PSR and 40a97664 fail.
